title: Differentiable Land Surface Energy Balance Model under Hard Physical Constraints
description: dLSEB is a JAX-based differentiable land surface energy balance model that couples radiative transfer, turbulent transport, and soil heat diffusion under a hard energy balance constraint solved via Newton's method, with the soil heat equation discretized by the Crank-Nicolson scheme. The model supports gradient-based parameter optimization and T0 data assimilation. Source code and data processing scripts for three desert sites (Ejin, Huazhaizi, Shenshawo) are included.
